chunks: What was narrated by ʿAlī ibn Ibrāhīm, from his father, from Ibn Abī ʿUmayr, from Jamīl, from Zurārah, from Abī Jaʿfar عليه السلام, who said:
For the person in janabah, whatever amount of water runs over his body—whether little of it or much—then it has sufficed him.

key_terms.أَجْزَأَهُ: it was sufficient and fulfilled the requirement
key_terms.الْجُنُبُ: a person in the state of janabah requiring ghusl
key_terms.جَسَدِهِ: his body over which the water must flow

ai.seo_question: What amount of water is sufficient for ghusl al-janabah?
ai.summary: This hadith gives a legal ruling concerning ghusl for janabah. It states that if water flows over the body, whether in a small amount or a large amount, the ghusl is sufficient.
